name: @explorer/parsers
description: Instruction-parsing contract and dispatcher shared by the explorer app and sibling packages — generic parsing cores, distinct from the per-program @explorer/decoder-* packages.

scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && vitest run && pnpm run test:treeshakability && pnpm run test:node-esm && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.test:node-esm: for entry in dist/index.js dist/compat/index.js; do node --input-type=module -e "import('./$entry')" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:treeshakability: for file in dist/index.js dist/compat/index.js; do agadoo $file || exit 1; done
